HOME SCIENCE — TERMLY EXAM #1
====

GRADE: Grade 10
SUBJECT: HOME SCIENCE
TIME ALLOWED: 1 hour 30 minutes
TOTAL MARKS: 50
EXAM BODY: KNEC / KCSE pathway

INSTRUCTIONS
----
1. Answer all questions.
2. For calculations, show formula → substitution → steps → final answer with units.
3. For multiple choice, choose the best option.
4. Check your work before submitting.

SECTION A — MULTIPLE CHOICE
----
1. Which change is a physical change? (1 mark)
   A. Ice melting to water
   B. Iron rusting
   C. Paper burning to ash
   D. Milk souring

2. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Housing the Family 2.4 Cleaning the House 2.5 Laundry Work 2.6 Consumer Educatio? (1 mark)
   A. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Housing the Family 2.4 Cleaning the House 2.5 Laundry Work 2.6 Consumer Educatio.
   B. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Housing the Family 2.4 Cleaning the House 2.5 Laundry Work 2.6 Consumer Educatio.
   C. Guess results without recording observations on Housing the Family 2.4 Cleaning the House 2.5 Laundry Work 2.6 Consumer Educatio.
   D. Skip labelling diagrams related to Housing the Family 2.4 Cleaning the House 2.5 Laundry Work 2.6 Consumer Educatio.

3. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Methods of Cooking? (1 mark)
   A. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Methods of Cooking.
   B. Guess results without recording observations on Methods of Cooking.
   C. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Methods of Cooking.
   D. Skip labelling diagrams related to Methods of Cooking.

4. Boiling point of pure water at standard pressure is about: (1 mark)
   A. 50 °C
   B. 37 °C
   C. 0 °C
   D. 100 °C

5. A compound differs from a mixture because: (1 mark)
   A. A mixture always has a fixed melting point
   B. A compound can be separated by filtering only
   C. Elements in a compound are chemically combined in a fixed ratio
   D. Mixtures cannot exist in Kenya

6. Photosynthesis mainly produces: (1 mark)
   A. Nitrogen gas only
   B. Glucose and oxygen
   C. Only water vapour
   D. Only carbon dioxide

7. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Nutritive Value of Foods? (1 mark)
   A. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Nutritive Value of Foods.
   B. Skip labelling diagrams related to Nutritive Value of Foods.
   C. Guess results without recording observations on Nutritive Value of Foods.
   D. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Nutritive Value of Foods.

8. Soil erosion is reduced by: (1 mark)
   A. Burning crop residue every week
   B. Removing all vegetation
   C. Planting cover crops and terracing slopes
   D. Overgrazing continuously

9. Why is water unsuitable for a petrol fire? (1 mark)
   A. Water always increases oxygen
   B. Water can spread burning petrol instead of putting it out safely
   C. Petrol fires have no fuel
   D. Water removes heat too quickly

10. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Hygiene During Puberty? (1 mark)
   A. Guess results without recording observations on Hygiene During Puberty.
   B. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Hygiene During Puberty.
   C. Skip labelling diagrams related to Hygiene During Puberty.
   D. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Hygiene During Puberty.

11. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Kitchen Layouts and Equipment? (1 mark)
   A. Guess results without recording observations on Kitchen Layouts and Equipment.
   B. Skip labelling diagrams related to Kitchen Layouts and Equipment.
   C. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Kitchen Layouts and Equipment.
   D. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Kitchen Layouts and Equipment.

12. An element is: (1 mark)
   A. Any white crystal used in cooking
   B. A pure substance that cannot be broken down into a simpler substance by chemical means
   C. Any substance that conducts electricity
   D. A mixture of two liquids

13. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Safety in the Home? (1 mark)
   A. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Safety in the Home.
   B. Guess results without recording observations on Safety in the Home.
   C. Skip labelling diagrams related to Safety in the Home.
   D. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Safety in the Home.

14. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Hygiene During Puberty 2.2 Safety in the Home 2.3 Housing the Family 2.4 Cleanin? (1 mark)
   A. Guess results without recording observations on Hygiene During Puberty 2.2 Safety in the Home 2.3 Housing the Family 2.4 Cleanin.
   B. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Hygiene During Puberty 2.2 Safety in the Home 2.3 Housing the Family 2.4 Cleanin.
   C. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Hygiene During Puberty 2.2 Safety in the Home 2.3 Housing the Family 2.4 Cleanin.
   D. Skip labelling diagrams related to Hygiene During Puberty 2.2 Safety in the Home 2.3 Housing the Family 2.4 Cleanin.

15. The SI unit of force is the: (1 mark)
   A. newton (N)
   B. watt (W)
   C. joule (J)
   D. pascal (Pa)

16. Diffusion is best described as: (1 mark)
   A. Movement of water only across a membrane
   B. Heating until a solid melts
   C. A chemical reaction forming ash
   D. Net movement of particles from high to low concentration

SECTION B — STRUCTURED / SHORT ANSWERS
----
17. In three clear sentences, explain Nutritive Value of Foods and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

18. In three clear sentences, explain Methods of Cooking 2.0 Home Management 2.1 Hygiene During Puberty 2.2 Safety in  and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

19. In three clear sentences, explain Methods of Cooking and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

20. In three clear sentences, explain Hygiene During Puberty 2.2 Safety in the Home 2.3 Housing the Family 2.4 Cleanin and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

21. In three clear sentences, explain Hygiene During Puberty and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

22. In three clear sentences, explain Safety in the Home and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)
